_comment: Shared 'house view' on markets — not personal to any user. Ships as a working default so a fresh install renders a dashboard immediately; portfolio-setup copies this into the project as an editable market-assumptions.json. Re-research and bump dates periodically (e.g. via the market-researcher dispatch in dashboard-refresh's SKILL.md Step 6).

analystAggressiveWeights._note: Analyst-favored sector weights for an aggressive equity book (% of equity), synthesized from 2026 Wall-Street sector overweights.

sectorGrowth._note: 2026 earnings-growth outlook by sector (FactSet / Schwab). dir drives the dashboard's up/down tag.

forecastRates._note: 5-year forecast assumptions (annual total return) by asset class.

marketBenchmark._note: Optional. A market index return (e.g. S&P 500) for the Momentum panel's 'vs the market' comparison — update by hand periodically, same cadence as sector-research and the rest of this file. Leave asof empty (as shipped here) to leave the comparison off; the dashboard skips it gracefully rather than showing a bogus '0% over an empty period' line. pct is a plain percent over periodLabel (e.g. summed monthly returns), not a precise price-to-price calc, so treat it as directional.
